Sonos Panel by almulder -- a self-hosted, touchscreen-friendly web app for controlling a whole-house Sonos system from cheap wall-mounted tablets.
Runs entirely on your LAN with no cloud dependency: all speaker control is local UPnP with real-time event subscriptions. Includes a built-in Network Music Library that streams your own music files straight to the speakers, sidestepping the Sonos 65,000-song index limit, plus room grouping, full queue management, playlists, favorites organized by service and account, an optional passcode lock for guest-proofing, and support for both Sonos S1 and S2 systems.
Support is handled through GitHub issues on the project repository.
